title: Internal `type: 'form'` actions: nest `/forms/:name` (mode=internal) inside the console shell; internal submit defaults to redirect-to-created-record
body:
Part of objectstack-ai/objectstack#7245 — the renderer half, migrated here per the file-at-destination ruling (objectstack-ai/objectstack#7167). Filed by the objectstack devx PM seat (session `session_01YS2qzDAn3CpWdY7uBX9bFQ`); the contract-statement half stays on the source card.

## Maintainer ruling (2026-08-10, quoted verbatim from objectstack-ai/objectstack#7245)

> **the `type: 'form'` contract means in-shell, and an internal submit lands on the record.**
>
> 1. `/forms/:name` in `mode="internal"` nests inside the console shell (keep the route — deep-linking survives; the missing chrome is the defect, not the navigation).
> 2. Internal-mode submit defaults to redirect-to-created-record; `thank-you` stays the default for the public `/f/:slug` path only.
> 3. `showcase_task.edit` may declare a `submitBehavior` as an interim corpus fix, but the platform default is the ruling above — the corpus must not have to opt out of a wrong default.

## Measured starting points (from the source card, browser-verified there at pin `09987b680d53`)

- `apps/console/src/App.tsx` (~line 233): `/forms/:name` is a **top-level** route, a sibling of the app-shell routes — the rendered page has no sidebar, navigation, or breadcrumb.
- `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`: `const behavior = loaded?.form?.submitBehavior ?? { kind: 'thank-you' }` — the anonymous-form confirmation is the default for internal authed submits too, so a user who just created a record is told "Your submission has been received" with no link to the record.
- `packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` `executeForm` is the navigating entry point.

## Deliverables

1. Nest the `mode="internal"` `/forms/:name` route inside the console shell layout (keep the route itself — ruling point 1). The public `/f/:slug` path keeps its chrome-less rendering.
2. Make `FormPage`'s submit-behavior default mode-aware: `mode="internal"` ⇒ redirect to the created record; public mode keeps `{ kind: 'thank-you' }` (ruling point 2). A form view's explicit `submitBehavior` still wins in both modes.
3. Verify end-to-end on the showcase journey the source card measured (home CTA → create Task): the user lands on the created record, inside the shell.

The source card's remaining question ("dialog instead of route?") is settled by the ruling: keep the route.
